01// EXPERIENCE

Principal-led engineering

Nearly 20 years close to the technical decisions.

Thanat Manasakool brings nearly 20 years in enterprise infrastructure, with experience as an Ecosystem Solutions Architect for Red Hat and Nutanix, delivering architecture guidance and technical enablement to Thailand's leading SI partners. His background spans enterprise platforms, partner technical support and hands-on delivery, including Red Hat OpenShift and Nutanix NKP.

02// APPROACH

What that means for your project

Architecture, integration and a team that can carry it.

The aim is a system your own team can understand, operate and improve after we hand it over.

  • 01

    Work with the environment you have

    Start from your infrastructure, dependencies, policies and operating limits. We explain the trade-offs and agree what evidence will show it is ready.

  • 02

    One person across the whole problem

    You discuss the business requirement and the implementation detail with the same person. Platform recommendations follow your requirements, not a product line.

  • 03

    Make consequential work accountable

    The authority to accept risk stays with the people responsible for it. Controlled execution and verification make AI useful inside those limits.

03// INDEPENDENCE

Independent advice

We work for you, and we protect your interests.

Thanat has worked with Red Hat and Nutanix, and some engagements do come through a vendor or an SI partner. We say so plainly so you can judge the technical background behind the advice and see where we have been. On your project, your interests are the ones we protect: recommendations follow your requirements and constraints, we say when a simpler or cheaper option would serve you better, and we disclose any relationship that could bear on our advice before it bears on a decision. We are not a reseller or a formally certified partner, and the scope and responsibilities of every engagement are agreed with you directly.

Discuss your infrastructure with the principal architect.
